requirements.statement: Changes MUST link acceptance criteria, decisions, backlog or issue, PR, evidence and release where applicable, and apply the Definition of Done with explicit justified not-applicable entries.
requirements.rationale: Review must distinguish specified behavior from shipped behavior.
requirements.required_evidence: Final PR assessment, linked positive/negative evidence and scoped release record.
requirements.enforcement: Register validator plus maintainer PR/release assessment; human semantic review is required.
requirements.gap: Product traceability exists; the extended completion and release chain has not been demonstrated.

requirements.statement: Main and supported release branches MUST require PR-based changes and passing CI, prohibit force-push, restrict bypass and retain maintainer assessment; independent review SHALL become required when another qualified maintainer exists.
requirements.rationale: A workflow file cannot enforce repository access controls.
requirements.required_evidence: Dated remote ruleset/branch protection and access assessment, required checks, and example final PR.
requirements.enforcement: Remote rulesets and periodic maintainer inspection; CODEOWNERS routes ownership without fake self-review.
requirements.gap: Main protection was inspected on 2026-10-02: required verify, admin enforcement, no force-push/deletion and zero required approvals. Final PR assessment and future release-branch settings remain unevidenced.

requirements.statement: Material technical choices MUST record context, alternatives, consequences, security, performance, operations, migration, reversibility and status in ADRs; product choices SHALL retain D-* records.
requirements.rationale: Technical acceptance must remain distinguishable from product scope.
requirements.required_evidence: ADRs linked to accepted decisions/source and explicit unresolved consistency boundaries.
requirements.enforcement: Maintainer design review using ADR template; register validates referenced files.
requirements.gap: Satisfied for the current bounded architecture record; future architecture changes require new evidence.

requirements.statement: CI MUST execute the shared full unit/integration matrix, formatting and lint checks; unavailable dependencies or tools SHALL fail rather than report skipped checks as success.
requirements.rationale: Local and CI evidence must have the same scope.
requirements.required_evidence: Final-commit full verification, Rust fmt/Clippy and Go format/vet output against real services.
requirements.enforcement: scripts/verify.py and ci.yml; CI status required by GOV-002.
requirements.gap: Source verification records are linked by immutable revision in the assessment; each candidate still requires its own final-source CI and qualification assessment.

requirements.statement: The repository MUST document reproducible development prerequisites, commands, component status, evidence boundaries, contribution rules and private vulnerability reporting.
requirements.rationale: Users must be able to reproduce bounded results without confusing a prototype with supported deployment.
requirements.required_evidence: Setup/testing guides, implementation inventory, contribution/security policies and links.
requirements.enforcement: Maintainer documentation review and setup regression tests.
requirements.gap: Development documentation exists; this requirement does not claim supported installation or production security.

requirements.statement: Alpha MUST deliver a coherent declared product slice through its promised interfaces, including access control, reload, conflict recovery and accepted domain rules.
requirements.rationale: Pure rules alone are not a usable product.
requirements.required_evidence: Acceptance-to-interface tests and maintainer scope decision, without silently reducing B-018 scope.
requirements.enforcement: Product acceptance and release assessment.
requirements.gap: Typed pure contracts exist; configurable storage/API/UI integration is pending.

requirements.statement: Trust boundaries and abuse cases MUST have a reviewed threat model with mitigations, residual risks and test destinations, updated on boundary changes.
requirements.rationale: Security decisions need explicit adversaries and assets.
requirements.required_evidence: Reviewed model and tests for authentication, authorization, replay, event and resource abuse.
requirements.enforcement: Security-impact PR review and Alpha assessment.
requirements.gap: Initial current/planned boundary model exists; mitigations and formal assessment remain incomplete.

requirements.statement: Every exposed read, mutation, configuration and replay path MUST authenticate and enforce current project/object grants; local owner onboarding, session expiry/recovery and browser CSRF protections SHALL be tested.
requirements.rationale: Loopback and origin checks do not establish identity or prevent IDOR.
requirements.required_evidence: Allow/deny, IDOR, cross-project, revoked-grant replay, session and CLI/browser negative tests.
requirements.enforcement: Authoritative service boundaries and security integration suite.
requirements.gap: Origin checks and pure grant rules exist; no integrated authentication or authorization baseline.

requirements.statement: Alpha MUST assess all applicable ASVS 5.0.0 Level 1 controls and OSPS 2025-02-25 Level 1 controls, retaining evidence and justified applicability decisions. An aggregate assessment score MUST NOT replace per-control evidence.
requirements.rationale: A targeted baseline requires complete scoped assessment rather than a badge.
requirements.required_evidence: Versioned per-control matrices and closed mandatory gaps, including repository MFA/access and private reporting availability.
requirements.enforcement: Alpha security qualification; incomplete matrices block release.
requirements.gap: No full ASVS/OSPS assessment exists.

requirements.statement: SAST, direct/transitive dependency vulnerability scanning and secret scanning MUST run on changes and regularly on supported branches, with owned actionable findings and expiring exceptions.
requirements.rationale: New advisories affect unchanged code too.
requirements.required_evidence: Pinned scanner configuration, real seeded detection regressions, scheduled output and triage records.
requirements.enforcement: Future security CI and vulnerability response; current compiler lints are not SAST coverage.
requirements.gap: Scanner/tool/database choices and hosted feature access require qualification; tracked in B-020/B-021.

requirements.statement: Production MUST satisfy all applicable ASVS 5 Level 2 and OSPS Level 2 controls with versioned evidence, secure deployment settings and closed critical/high exploitable findings. An aggregate assessment score MUST NOT replace per-control evidence.
requirements.rationale: Broad adoption requires stronger verification than local development.
requirements.required_evidence: Complete matrices, hardened install tests and remediated findings; any source-standard exceptions disclosed.
requirements.enforcement: Production security sign-off, never inferred from Alpha assessment.
requirements.gap: Development credentials and disabled search authentication are explicitly unsuitable for production.

requirements.statement: Dependencies MUST follow the dependency policy for licenses, direct/transitive advisories, maintenance, updates and owned expiring exceptions.
requirements.rationale: A lockfile is inventory evidence, not security or license clearance.
requirements.required_evidence: Dependency/license inventory, update/triage record, notices and exception reviews.
requirements.enforcement: Dependency PR review now; automated inventory/scanning qualification in B-021.
requirements.gap: Policy and Rust lockfile exist; complete transitive/image license and advisory evidence is missing.

requirements.statement: Public HTTP APIs MUST be OpenAPI contract-first with tested schemas, stable error codes/envelope, pagination/filter/sort rules, authorization, bounded requests, resource limits, concurrency conflicts, replay, versioning and deprecation.
requirements.rationale: Polyglot adapters must not independently reinterpret errors and retry semantics.
requirements.required_evidence: Validated specification, cross-language positive/negative conformance and compatibility diff; documented endpoint applicability.
requirements.enforcement: Future contract validation and API integration tests; design review now.
requirements.gap: Experimental errors include operation_id_reused/version_conflict; no supported OpenAPI contract exists.

requirements.statement: Same operation ID and intent MUST return the original accepted result within its retention contract; changed intent SHALL reject with operation_id_reused and stale unseen intent with version_conflict. Authentication/authorization MUST precede replay.
requirements.rationale: Unknown write outcomes must be safely reconciled without duplicate effects.
requirements.required_evidence: Pure and actual-storage replay/race tests, scope/fingerprint/expiry/restore tests and API mappings.
requirements.enforcement: Domain replay logic, immutable storage uniqueness, service access checks and integration tests.
requirements.gap: Bounded single-task ledger exists; scoped configurable replay/access/compaction/restore integration is pending.

requirements.statement: Accepted task versions MUST increase monotonically; mutation/version/replay acceptance SHALL be atomic for the promised scope and independent of search. Cross-record invariants MUST have a demonstrated commit/recovery protocol before exposure.
requirements.rationale: Single-record success cannot justify consistent configuration, allocation or accounting.
requirements.required_evidence: Storage uniqueness tests, contention/crash evidence and domain-to-enforcing-layer invariant table.
requirements.enforcement: Domain rules, database keys and service tests; unresolved Q-019 blocks affected routes.
requirements.gap: Finite single-task race evidence is not linearizability proof or cross-document consistency.

requirements.statement: Events MUST carry ID/type/schema version, aggregate ID/version, timestamp and correlation ID, with causation ID where useful; consumers SHALL define duplicate, delayed, reordered, missing, future-schema and poison handling. Projections and clients MUST never regress authoritative versions.
requirements.rationale: Search freshness and authority are different contracts.
requirements.required_evidence: Versioned event schemas, producer/consumer tests, gap/rebuild and poison replay evidence.
requirements.enforcement: Schema/contract tests, consumer version gates, client merge rules and recovery tooling.
requirements.gap: Minimum-version search check and bounded Python spike evidence exist; production CDC/indexer/event envelope is absent.

requirements.statement: Supported installation MUST retain acknowledged writes, configuration and replay state across process crash, container recreation and ordinary machine restart, with verified storage mapping/index/CDC readiness and separate setup privileges.
requirements.rationale: Disposable Compose and DB acknowledgment do not establish restart durability.
requirements.required_evidence: Actual supported-runtime termination/restart and durable-volume tests with independent reads.
requirements.enforcement: Provisioning/readiness plus supported-runtime qualification.
requirements.gap: Bounded worker/spike evidence exists; main Compose has ephemeral data and no supported durability qualification.

requirements.statement: Supported real-data use MUST have automated daily backup with visible age/failure, an off-machine/failure-domain copy, clean-instance restore of authoritative/configuration/replay state, search reconstruction and stale-client/retry handling.
requirements.rationale: Backup execution alone is not recoverability.
requirements.required_evidence: Restore exercise, backup failure/sleep scenarios, replay/tombstone and concurrent rebuild checks.
requirements.enforcement: Backup monitoring and restore qualification; no real-data readiness until demonstrated.
requirements.gap: No supported backup or clean-instance restore exists.

requirements.statement: RPO/RTO MUST be explicitly decided for each supported failure class, with recovery procedures and measurable successful restore criteria.
requirements.rationale: A daily backup cannot justify an unconditional 24-hour RPO.
requirements.required_evidence: Approved objective record and timed exercises covering source data, replay state and search recovery.
requirements.enforcement: Recovery qualification and Q-020 decision; no invented numerical targets.
requirements.gap: Exact loss/time objectives and backup destination remain open.

requirements.statement: Production MUST demonstrate approved RPO/RTO under loss of the supported host/storage failure domain and verify source integrity, replay safety and rebuilt projections.
requirements.rationale: An in-place restore cannot establish disaster recovery.
requirements.required_evidence: Timed independent-environment recovery, integrity comparison and operator evidence.
requirements.enforcement: Production release and recurring recovery campaigns.
requirements.gap: Machine-loss recovery and tested objectives remain future work.

requirements.statement: High-risk parsers and mutation contracts MUST have property/fuzz coverage for valid/invalid Unicode and escaping, size/complexity boundaries, replay intent, stale versions and nondecreasing projection versions.
requirements.rationale: Example cases leave large input/state spaces unexplored.
requirements.required_evidence: Seeded bounded PR properties, retained regression corpus and separate time-bounded Rust fuzz campaigns.
requirements.enforcement: Deterministic CI properties and scheduled qualification; fuzz discovery must become regression tests.
requirements.gap: Example/boundary tests exist; systematic properties/fuzzing and parser complexity bounds are incomplete.

requirements.statement: Critical invariants MUST be exercised by deterministic concurrency, sustained contention, state-machine/model tests where appropriate and hypothesis-driven dependency/crash fault injection.
requirements.rationale: Finite race tests are evidence, not proof; random chaos has no acceptance oracle.
requirements.required_evidence: Campaign parameters, interruption barriers, invariant oracles and failures across the QUALIFICATION matrix.
requirements.enforcement: Real-service release campaigns and bounded CI regressions.
requirements.gap: Finite races/stalls and prototype failure cases exist; full production path and sustained/model qualification are pending.

requirements.statement: Beta MUST exercise critical supported user paths through client, API, worker, persistence, events and projection, including denied access, uncertain outcomes and reload.
requirements.rationale: Component probes cannot establish the integrated user experience.
requirements.required_evidence: Selective deterministic actual-stack E2E with bounded waits and final-state oracles.
requirements.enforcement: Future system test suite and release qualification.
requirements.gap: No application UI or complete production event path exists.

requirements.statement: Alpha MUST measure p50/p95/p99 for mutation, authoritative read and available search/propagation operations with dataset, concurrency, hardware, versions and resource usage recorded.
requirements.rationale: Timeout constants are not measured latency or scale.
requirements.required_evidence: Repeatable benchmark output including CPU, memory, storage growth and startup.
requirements.enforcement: Benchmark qualification separate from noisy PR latency assertions.
requirements.gap: SP-001 resource observations are bounded prototype results, not application performance qualification.

requirements.statement: Beta MUST publish a measured operating envelope for supported tasks/projects, fields, clients and throughput, including saturation, CDC propagation, index rebuild, startup, disk growth, CPU and memory; Production SHALL qualify the supported envelope.
requirements.rationale: An architectural ambition is not enterprise-scale evidence.
requirements.required_evidence: Workload distributions, p50/p95/p99, errors, saturation limits and repeatable volume/rebuild results.
requirements.enforcement: Beta/Production benchmark campaigns and release scope decisions in Q-022.
requirements.gap: No measured Go/Rust operating envelope or approved capacity targets.

requirements.statement: User/workload-controlled request/query complexity, filters, fields, task/event size, search results, concurrency and queue growth MUST have enforced bounds and rejection/backpressure contracts; future attachments SHALL be bounded before exposure.
requirements.rationale: Unbounded dimensions invite resource exhaustion and hidden growth.
requirements.required_evidence: Limit inventory, maximum/over-limit tests and reviewed justification for any unbounded dimension.
requirements.enforcement: Domain limits, adapter admission and queue retention policies.
requirements.gap: Worker and logical model have bounds; full API/query/queue/event limits and retained-history policy remain incomplete.

requirements.statement: Services MUST expose structured logs, metrics and propagated trace context, including request rate/duration/errors/active requests, DB pools, mutation failures/retries, CDC lag, event backlog, projection lag, indexing failures and poison/dead-letter counts where applicable.
requirements.rationale: Projection lag must be diagnosable separately from durability.
requirements.required_evidence: Telemetry schema, exporter/instrumentation tests, context propagation and bounded-cardinality/redaction checks.
requirements.enforcement: Instrumentation tests and operational dashboards/alerts; avoid IDs as metric labels.
requirements.gap: No integrated OTel-compatible model exists.

requirements.statement: Supported releases MUST define measurable SLIs/SLOs for API availability, mutation durability, authoritative-read/search latency, search freshness and recovery success, including windows, populations and exclusions.
requirements.rationale: Objectives require reliable measurements and failure attribution.
requirements.required_evidence: Approved SLI formulas/targets and telemetry queries; Production must retain achieved-window evidence.
requirements.enforcement: SLO assessment, alert/runbook review and Q-020/Q-022 decisions; targets remain undecided.
requirements.gap: Neither final numerical targets nor instrumented SLO evidence exists.

requirements.statement: Production MUST demonstrate its approved SLOs over the declared qualification window and close critical integrity architecture gaps for shipped capabilities.
requirements.rationale: Defining an objective does not demonstrate it is achieved.
requirements.required_evidence: Actual SLO reports, integrity disposition and operational qualification for the support matrix.
requirements.enforcement: Production qualification review; unresolved Q-019 cannot be hidden by passing single-task tests.
requirements.gap: No supported-window SLO results; cross-document protocol remains unresolved.

requirements.statement: Supported configuration MUST have a schema, safe defaults, precedence, secret separation, startup validation, incompatible-combination rejection and compatibility rules; liveness, readiness and degraded capabilities SHALL be distinct.
requirements.rationale: A live process may be unable to serve authoritative operations.
requirements.required_evidence: Invalid/startup configuration and dependency-failure tests with documented capability responses.
requirements.enforcement: Startup/service validation and dependency matrix in QUALIFICATION; future config validation CLI requires design.
requirements.gap: Development bounds and index health exist; supported config schema and complete health model do not.

requirements.statement: Supported releases MUST provide tested install, upgrade, backup, restore, health, database failure, search rebuild, CDC backlog, poison recovery, disk-full, secret-rotation and crash-recovery runbooks.
requirements.rationale: Operators need a recoverable workflow rather than undocumented repair commands.
requirements.required_evidence: Runbooks executed by an operator with prerequisites, verification, rollback and escalation.
requirements.enforcement: Operational qualification using runbook template; placeholders are not completion.
requirements.gap: Development setup guide exists; supported operational runbooks are pending.

requirements.statement: Migrations MUST be explicitly versioned and deterministic, test every supported previous-version upgrade at realistic volume, expose progress/failure, document recovery and require backup before destructive changes.
requirements.rationale: Schema changes must preserve history and operation state.
requirements.required_evidence: Version fixtures, interruption/resume or rollback evidence and supported-path matrix.
requirements.enforcement: Future migration suite and release qualification; no ad-hoc framework is mandated now.
requirements.gap: Index installation is not a supported migration system.

requirements.statement: Beta MUST declare compatibility/version/deprecation rules for HTTP API, events, configuration, storage, CLI and public contracts, with supported upgrade paths; 0.x breaking changes SHALL be documented.
requirements.rationale: Clients and stored data cannot safely upgrade on implicit assumptions.
requirements.required_evidence: Compatibility matrix, schema diffs, old-client/event tests and upgrade fixtures.
requirements.enforcement: Contract/release review and migration tests.
requirements.gap: No supported API or release compatibility contract exists.

requirements.statement: From 1.0, supported public surfaces MUST obey SemVer: incompatible changes require a major release; deprecations SHALL state replacement and removal version/window, and supported upgrades MUST preserve promised data/replay semantics.
requirements.rationale: Version numbers must carry a concrete supported behavior contract.
requirements.required_evidence: Published support matrix, changelog and deprecation policy with tested old/new paths.
requirements.enforcement: Release compatibility assessment and artifact qualification.
requirements.gap: Workspace 0.1.0 is not a supported compatibility commitment.

requirements.statement: Release builds MUST bind an immutable source commit to pinned toolchains, lockfiles, digest-pinned images/actions and controlled fetched dependencies; OCI packaging SHALL apply where containers are distributed.
requirements.rationale: Mutable stable tags/version tags are insufficient release input control.
requirements.required_evidence: Build input inventory, resolved digests and clean hosted build record.
requirements.enforcement: Future release pipeline and dependency pin/update review.
requirements.gap: Rust lockfile/version-tagged development images exist; stable toolchain and action tags remain mutable.

requirements.statement: Beta releases MUST include per-artifact SPDX or CycloneDX SBOM, checksums and hosted signed build provenance verifiably bound to artifact digests and source, with an assessed SLSA 1.2 Build L2 builder and consumer verification instructions.
requirements.rationale: Provenance must be authenticated and checked against expected source/build identity.
requirements.required_evidence: Artifact-level inventories, signatures, verification tests and Build L2 control assessment.
requirements.enforcement: Future hosted build/release pipeline; provenance file alone is not SLSA attainment.
requirements.gap: No release SBOM, signed provenance or builder assessment.

requirements.statement: Production artifacts or a digest manifest covering every artifact MUST be signed, with checksums, SBOM, provenance and documented trusted identity/key verification and rotation/revocation procedures.
requirements.rationale: Signed provenance and release-artifact authenticity are separate requirements.
requirements.required_evidence: Consumer signature verification, tampered-artifact negative tests and signing incident procedure.
requirements.enforcement: Publication gate after verification → security checks → build → tests → SBOM → provenance → signing → packaging.
requirements.gap: No supported release signing/publication pipeline.

requirements.statement: The project SHOULD run OpenSSF Scorecard continuously where hosted access permits, retain per-check findings and triage trends.
requirements.rationale: Repository controls can drift independently of source tests.
requirements.required_evidence: Scheduled assessment and owned findings or a documented feasibility rationale with review date.
requirements.enforcement: Future read-only scheduled assessment, kept separate from deterministic PR checks.
requirements.gap: Hosted permissions/publication prerequisites have not been qualified.

requirements.statement: Supported releases MUST follow SECURITY.md response targets and a private-report → triage/severity → remediation → advisory/CVE or GHSA where applicable → patched release → coordinated disclosure → postmortem process.
requirements.rationale: Release users need a predictable remediation and learning path.
requirements.required_evidence: Enabled private reporting, incident exercise, advisory/patch workflow and support contacts.
requirements.enforcement: Maintainer incident procedure and Production exercise; existing targets remain unchanged.
requirements.gap: Reporting/response policy exists; supported-release response and exercise are future work.

requirements.statement: The supported web UI MUST meet WCAG 2.2 AA, including keyboard operation, semantic HTML, screen-reader behavior, contrast, focus handling and accessible validation/errors.
requirements.rationale: Interaction capability includes access beyond pointer use.
requirements.required_evidence: Scoped automated accessibility checks plus manual keyboard/screen-reader evaluation across supported browsers.
requirements.enforcement: UI acceptance and Production qualification; automation cannot replace manual testing.
requirements.gap: No real application UI exists; no browser tooling is introduced for an absent UI.

requirements.statement: Enterprise claims MUST be scoped to approved customer requirements and evidenced identity (OIDC, justified SAML/SSO, MFA), RBAC/ABAC, audit, HA, horizontal scaling/multi-node recovery, stronger backup, isolation if multi-tenant, observability, hardening and external penetration/compliance assessments.
requirements.rationale: Enterprise readiness is a capability/evidence decision, not a marketing label.
requirements.required_evidence: Scope/applicability decisions, independent security assessment and realistic enterprise failure/isolation/recovery qualification.
requirements.enforcement: Later enterprise initiative; consider SLSA Build L3 after builder threat-model review.
requirements.gap: Candidate later scope only; multi-tenancy, SAML and certification are not implied requirements today.

requirements.statement: New and materially changed code MUST apply the Coding Standard with scoped review/test evidence; existing untouched gaps SHALL remain recorded with implementation destinations, and narrow exceptions SHALL have owner, rationale, mitigation and expiry/review date.
requirements.rationale: Coding rules must protect domain invariants and execution ownership without forcing unrelated legacy rewrites or claiming repository-wide conformance.
requirements.required_evidence: PR scope and applicable-rule assessment, relevant compiler/format/lint and behavioral results, and existing gap or exception dispositions with backlog references.
requirements.enforcement: Existing Rust/Go format/lint and unsafe checks, shared register validation, and maintainer assessment using the contribution policy, Definition of Done and PR template. Semantic conformance remains a review obligation.
requirements.gap: The scoped coding baseline and existing checks are documented; conformance across future material changes needs actual PR evidence. Architecture-boundary, Python/TypeScript and minimum-Rust-version qualification remain incomplete; no full legacy audit is claimed.
